title: pwa-primetime-coming-storm
label: Totakoxe Salvador

won.source: Already champion (C) when the surviving record opens: the Wayback capture of a 5 Feb 2003 news post bills the 9 Feb 2003 "Sunday Night Rave!" card's main singles match as "Singles Match for Tempest's Coming Storm Championship — Totakoxe Salvador (C) vs. Shawn Stewart."

note: No result for the 9 Feb 2003 defense survives, and no later champion is on record. A June 2003 news post (newsdata/2.news) runs a third-round tournament "for the soon to be renamed PWA Championship" without naming a result; whether that tournament ever crowned a successor to this reign is not in the surviving record.
